title: And he recalled the shrewd northern face of the rector who had taught him to construe the Metamorphoses of Ovid in a courtly English
html_source:
Recall the epigraph, from Ovid’s Metamorphoses:

Et ignotas animum dimittit in artes.

(And he turned his mind to unknown arts.)

anchor.text: and he recalled the shrewd northern face of the rector who had taught him to construe the Metamorphoses of Ovid in a courtly English
